name: Olbia Costa Smeralda Airport

handling.v: Private-flight handling runs 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, on a 10-hectare apron for private flights
handling.quote: Handling operations are managed 24 hours a day, 7 days a week on a 10-hectare apron

notes: Read the Olbia Service Charter 2026 (ENAC site, information updated to 26 Mar 2026). It gives the passenger terminal as open 05:00–23:00, which is not the aerodrome's operating hours, and says customs offices are in the arrivals area, without hours. ENAV AIP not opened (registration). No runway data from an official source.
